executive_summary.root_cause: HT-044 code is NOT active in the running container. The uvicorn process was started before migration 026 and the power source files were committed. The ./src volume is mounted but uvicorn was launched without --reload; it loaded the pre-HT-044 snapshot at startup. The running process has zero HT-044 Python objects in memory. A container restart (docker compose restart api) is required to deploy HT-044 into the live app.
executive_summary.impact: All five validation scenarios are blocked — Settings/Power (404), device Power (W) field (absent), API /api/power/* routes (404), dashboard Power Usage card (absent), map location power total (absent).
executive_summary.migration_status: Unknown from browser alone. Migration 026 (add power_watts + power_settings table) may or may not have been applied; Alembic runs at each startup so it would apply on next container restart.

findings.title: Settings → Power page returns NiceGUI 404 — route not registered
findings.observed: NiceGUI 404 page: 'This page doesn't exist. HTTPException: 404: Not Found'
findings.expected: Admin electricity rate form with cost-per-kWh and currency inputs
findings.steps_to_reproduce: 1. Log in as admin. 2. Navigate to /settings/power.
findings.root_cause: settings_power NiceGUI page is defined in src/ui/pages/settings_power.py and imported in src/main.py, but the running uvicorn process was started before this file existed in the volume. Route is not registered in the running app.

findings.title: API /api/power/summary and /api/power/settings return 404 — router not registered
findings.observed: NiceGUI 404 HTML response (status 200 content-type text/html); /openapi.json contains zero paths matching 'power'
findings.expected: JSON power summary with total_watts, estimated_monthly_cost, by_location[]
findings.steps_to_reproduce: 1. POST /api/auth/login to get token. 2. GET /api/power/summary with Authorization: Bearer <token>. 3. Observe 404 HTML.
findings.root_cause: power router (src/api/routers/power.py) is registered in app.py with app.include_router(power_router, prefix='/api'), but the running uvicorn process pre-dates this registration.
findings.supporting_evidence: openapi.json inspection: 52 paths total, none containing 'power'. /api/health returns 200 JSON, confirming API is up.

findings.title: Device edit page has no Power (W) field
findings.action: Open device edit for any existing device
findings.observed: Fields shown: Name, Type, Status, IP, MAC, OS, Notes. No 'Power (W)' input.
findings.expected: A numeric 'Power (W)' input field per HT-044 AC
findings.root_cause: Device edit page is rendered by the pre-HT-044 code snapshot; power_watts was not yet in DeviceBase at startup.

findings.title: Dashboard shows no Power Usage card
findings.observed: Dashboard cards: Devices (21), Connections (5), Locations (2), Tags (0), Recent Activity. No 'Power Usage' card.
findings.expected: Power Usage card showing total watts and estimated monthly cost
findings.root_cause: Dashboard component not updated with power card in running process.

findings.title: Inventory table has no Power (W) column or toggle
findings.observed: Columns: Name, Type, Status, IP, Tags, Location, Services, Networks, Updated, Actions. No Power (W) column or column-visibility toggle for it.
findings.expected: Optional Power (W) column available (hidden by default, toggleable)

findings.title: Map location drawer has no Total power line
findings.action: Click location marker 'HT008 Geo 16584a', inspect drawer
findings.observed: Drawer shows: location name, '1 device', device button. No 'Total power: XW' line.
findings.expected: Location drawer shows 'Total power: {sum}W ({count} devices)' when devices have power values
findings.steps_to_reproduce: 1. Navigate to /map. 2. Click the map marker. 3. Observe drawer content.
findings.root_cause: Map component pre-dates HT-044; also no devices have power_watts values in the running app.
